title: Resolve the acting session from ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID after BEE_SESSION_ID
action: In session_identity.rs make SESSION_ENV_VARS hold four names in this order: BEE_SESSION_ID, ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, PI_SESSION_ID. Delete the stale header comment block at the top of the file that lists the old three-name order (no new comments anywhere). Fix any existing unit test in the file whose expectation depended on the old array length or order, and make the cfg(test) ambient filter in env_session_id still ignore an inherited ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID the same way it ignores PI_SESSION_ID. Do not change locate_caller_from.
verify_owner: the cell's scoped proof — its worker runs it; the full suite runs once per feature, before merge

truths: resolve_env_session_id_from returns the ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID value when BEE_SESSION_ID is unset and both ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID are set
BEE_SESSION_ID still wins over every other name
